description: Taking the filter of a deductively closed propositional theory and then its inverse-image theory returns the original theory.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.theory_filter_inverse.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (T : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory α)
  (hT : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.IsClosed T) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.theoryOfFilter
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.filterOfTheory T hT) =
    T
